# Sportiverse

> Sportiverse is an all-in-one sports app for clubs, leagues, and players. Manage your club, run your league, and track every match — built for the people who live and breathe sport. Available on iOS (TestFlight beta) and Android (beta access).

Website: https://sportiverse.no/

## Pages

- [Home](https://sportiverse.no/): Product overview, features, and beta access
- [Privacy Policy](https://sportiverse.no/privacy.html): How Sportiverse collects, uses, and protects data
- [Terms & Conditions](https://sportiverse.no/terms.html): Terms for using the app and services
- [Delete Account](https://sportiverse.no/delete-account.html): How to delete your Sportiverse account and data
